entities.summary: Kaedan Korczak is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Vegas Golden Knights of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted by the Golden Knights in the 2019 NHL entry draft after spending four seasons with the Kelowna Rockets of the Western Hockey League (WHL).
